answer: The judge cost of the four cheap stages is MEASURED wall_seconds on a caller-supplied fixture in this process. Evidence-production cost (hidden replay, logits, generate, live mission) is UNMEASURED because this sidecar does not spawn the resident. EXPENSIVE_QUALIFICATION is UNMEASURED: qualification_pipeline.execute always refuses and the skip is not a pass.

bench.machine: Apple host CPU; receipt/header metadata only
bench.rule: no hardware measurement claim without hardware

claim_boundary: Static sidecar artifact. No hardware measurement and no generate. A stage PASS is only the measurement that stage names. Hidden-state cosine is not capability (functional_role_probe / S031 §9). Next-token argmax is not capability (meta_funnel logit_token_validation). A SKIPPED stage is not a pass. This sidecar never chooses the component under test; a missing component.id is a refusal. Wall seconds in the receipt are judge time on caller-supplied evidence in this process, not resident generate time and not a qualified token cost. evidence_class STATIC_ONLY. gpu_authority false.

expensive_qualification.reason: qualification_pipeline.execute raises unless --execute, an existing HCLI lease, and QUIESCENT all hold — and then raises anyway because this sidecar has no GPU authority

fast_probes.prompt: What is the capital of France? Answer in one word.
Choose ONE and reply with only its name: freshness.py, negative_index.py, hbm_doctor.py. Which most likely reveals a stale artifact?
Compute 17 * 19. Reply with only the number.

component.note: build() supplies a fixture so the judges can be timed. This is not a scientific selection of a resident organ.

cost.evidence_production_reason: producing hidden states is a CPU replay or a generate this sidecar does not run; only the cosine judge is timed here
cost.reason: judge wall time on caller-supplied evidence in this process; not resident generate time

stages.does_not_establish: Not capability, not next-token identity, not checkable-task competence, not HCLI mission competence, and not qualification. S031 §9 forbids local cosine as the final verdict. A role can carry unequal capability value while carrying equal fidelity value.
stages.evidence_production_reason: producing hidden states is a CPU replay or a generate this sidecar does not run; only the cosine judge is timed here
stages.measures: Hidden-state cosine between caller-supplied incumbent and candidate activations, judged against capability_information_map.HIDDEN_COSINE_BAR. This is the SUB2 LOCAL_FUNCTIONAL_FIDELITY instrument (functional_role_probe.MEASURED_LEVEL=LOCAL_FUNCTIONAL_FIDELITY).
stages.required_input: hidden_a and hidden_b (incumbent vs candidate hidden state)

cost.evidence_production_reason: producing logits requires a forward / LM-head this sidecar does not run; only KL/top-k/argmax on supplied logits are timed
cost.reason: judge wall time on caller-supplied evidence in this process; not resident generate time

stages.does_not_establish: Not checkable-task competence, not HCLI mission competence, and not qualification. meta_funnel gate 5: token-level identity on a stated probe is not bounded capability. Argmax agreement is not logit parity (aux_capability_screen.ArgmaxAloneParityRefuse).
stages.evidence_production_reason: producing logits requires a forward / LM-head this sidecar does not run; only KL/top-k/argmax on supplied logits are timed
stages.measures: Next-token logits: KL(incumbent || candidate), top-k agreement, logits cosine, and argmax agreement. KL and top-k are the screen; argmax is a side report and is not parity.
stages.reason: KL 0.000000 (bar 0.1) top-5 agreement 1.0000 (bar 0.8) argmax_agreement 1.0 (argmax is not the pass criterion)
stages.required_input: logits_a and logits_b (incumbent vs candidate next-token logits)

cost.evidence_production_reason: producing answers requires a generate this sidecar does not spawn; only the deterministic predicates are timed
cost.reason: judge wall time on caller-supplied evidence in this process; not resident generate time

stages.does_not_establish: HCLI mission competence, protected qualification, or that a live resident generate would match these answers. A three-item checkable floor is not the capability contract; the larger headless suite is not imported and is not this stage.
stages.evidence_production_reason: producing answers requires a generate this sidecar does not spawn; only the deterministic predicates are timed
stages.measures: A small fixed prompt set with deterministic predicates (capital of France, HCLI stale-artifact choice, 17*19). Degenerate replies that contain a checkable token still fail (resident_provider quality / MEASURED_DEGENERATE_CHOICE).
stages.origin: tools/future/resident_provider.py::PROMPT_FRANCE, PROMPT_CHOICE, quality, MEASURED_DEGENERATE_CHOICE; tools/headless/capability_suite.py fact-arith cited not imported
stages.required_input: answers keyed by probe id (fact-capital, fact-choice, fact-arith)

cost.evidence_production_reason: producing a live mission emission requires the resident; only WorkUnit validation is timed here
cost.reason: judge wall time on caller-supplied evidence in this process; not resident generate time

stages.does_not_establish: Protected qualification, throughput, or that the resident will emit this under a live mission loop. Valid work-request shape is necessary and not sufficient for mission competence.
stages.evidence_production_reason: producing a live mission emission requires the resident; only WorkUnit validation is timed here
stages.measures: Whether caller-supplied emissions are valid structured HCLI work requests under workunit_species.validate_emitted_unit (core fields, claim_boundary, verifier, HCLI-safe effect_class).
stages.required_input: emissions: one or more WorkUnit mappings or JSON objects

cost.reason: EXPENSIVE_QUALIFICATION is declared but this sidecar has no GPU authority; qualification_pipeline.execute always refuses. This is a skip, not a pass.

stages.does_not_establish: Anything, when SKIPPED. A polite refusal is not a pass and is not a fail of the model. This sidecar has no GPU authority and will not seize an HCLI lease.
stages.evidence_production_reason: protected qualification requires a GPU lease this sidecar will not take; qualification_pipeline.execute always refuses
stages.measures: Nothing on this sidecar. The stage is declared so a caller can name the depth. qualification_pipeline.execute always raises; stages 10-12 of that pipeline emit a REQUEST/SPEC and stop.
stages.reason: EXPENSIVE_QUALIFICATION is declared but this sidecar has no GPU authority; qualification_pipeline.execute always refuses. This is a skip, not a pass.
stages.required_input: a protected GPU lease and a QUIESCENT machine, which this sidecar will not take or coerce
